en.title: Accessibility Tech Advances: Briksen Tool, Wolverine PS5 Features, Dax Robot Lead Updates
en.summary: Briksen has launched a new tool to detect WCAG accessibility gaps in Figma and CI/CD pipelines, helping designers catch issues early. Meanwhile, Marvel's Wolverine PS5 trailer highlights extensive accessibility options, and Missoula County deploys robot Dax to aid navigation for people with disabilities. Additionally, Belton seeks public input on its ADA Transition Plan, and Deaf Awareness Month events are announced.

highlights.title: Briksen Tool to Detect WCAG Gaps in Figma and CI/CD
New Marvel's Wolverine PS5 Trailer Breaks Down Gameplay Features, Accessibility Options, More - Push Square
Meet Dax: The robot helping Missoula County improve accessibility
Belton seeking community input on ADA Transition Plan to improve accessibility

zh-TW.title: 無障礙技術更新：Briksen工具、PS5金鋼狼、Dax機器人導覽
zh-TW.summary: Briksen 推出新工具，可在 Figma 與 CI/CD 流程中偵測 WCAG 無障礙差距，協助設計師早期發現問題。同時，《驚奇金鋼狼》PS5 預告片展示豐富的無障礙選項，Missoula 縣則部署機器人 Dax 協助殘障人士在公共場所導航。此外，貝爾頓徵求社區意見以改善 ADA 過渡計畫，並宣布聾人意識月活動。

highlights.title: Briksen 工具可偵測 Figma 與 CI/CD 中的 WCAG 差距
新作《驚奇金鋼狼》PS5 預告片解析玩法特色、無障礙選項等 - Push Square
認識 Dax：協助 Missoula 縣改善無障礙的機器人
贝尔顿正在征求社区意见，以制定其ADA过渡计划，旨在改善残障人士的无障碍环境。
